description: Loan identifier. Joins the tables; not a feature.
Month of the record. Orders time; every lag is counted from it.
Servicer at the reporting date. A change of servicer can follow arrears, so use month t-1.
Interest rate at the reporting date. Changes on modification.
Balance at the reporting date. Set to zero in the exit month and masked in the first six months, so use month t-1.
treatment_note: Stored as given. Filling the masked early months is left to the module that first needs it.

description: Months since origination at the reporting date.
Months left to legal maturity at the reporting date.
Months left to maturity at the reporting date, after prepayments.
Maturity date at the reporting date. Changes on modification.
Months left before an interest-only loan starts to repay principal.
Months in arrears at the reporting date. The month t value is the default target, so models use month t-1.
treatment_note: Months in arrears as text. XX means the status was not known that month; 99 means 99 months or more. Kept as given.

description: 24-month payment record up to the reporting date. Blank once the loan leaves the pool, so use month t-1.
Loan modified at or before the reporting date.
treatment_note: Y, N or blank. It can go from Y back to N, so "ever modified" must be built from all months up to t-1, not from the latest month.

description: Why the loan left the pool. Outcome; filled only in the exit month.
treatment_note: Blank while the loan is active. Codes: 01 prepaid or matured; 02 third-party sale; 03 short sale; 06 repurchased; 09 deed-in-lieu or REO; 15 non-performing note sale; 16 reperforming note sale; 96 removal (non-credit). Any other code fails the load.

description: Date the loan left the pool. Outcome.

layout_name: UPB at the Time of Removal
description: Balance when the loan left the pool. Outcome.
Principal paid in the month. In the month a loan pays off it equals the whole balance, so use month t-1.
Last paid instalment date. Filled only for loans that exit with code 02, 03, 09 or 15 (Fannie Mae FAQ Q55; 0 live rows in the test data). Outcome.
Date of foreclosure. Outcome.
Date the property was sold or the loan settled. Outcome.
Cost of foreclosure. Loss.
Cost of keeping and repairing the property. Loss.
Cost of recovering the property. Loss.
Other holding costs and credits. Loss.
Taxes paid while holding the property. Loss.
Cash from selling the property. Recovery.
Cash from mortgage insurance and other cover. Recovery.
Cash from the lender buying the loan back. Recovery.
Other cash from foreclosure. Recovery.
Part of the balance that bears no interest after a modification.
Principal forgiven, usually with a modification. Loss to the lender; never non-zero in the test data.
Change in servicing activity in the month.
Principal written off as uncollectable after foreclosure. Loss; 572 non-zero values sit on rows without an exit code (2005Q1).
Forbearance, repayment or trial plan at the reporting date.
Lender bought the loan back. Outcome.
Payment deferral or other arrears resolution at the reporting date.
Number of payment deferrals up to the reporting date.
Balance deferred up to the reporting date.
Payment deferral treated as a modification in the month.
Quarter Fannie Mae acquired the loan, taken from the file name. Groups loans by vintage; not a feature.
Months in arrears as a whole number, built from delinquency_status. Same lag.
treatment_note: delinquency_status as a whole number. XX and blank become NULL, so a NULL here is not "up to date".

description: Label of zero_balance_code. Outcome.
treatment_note: Label of zero_balance_code, from the same 8 codes. NULL while the loan is active.

description: Arrears status not known that month (XX), built from delinquency_status. Same lag.
treatment_note: TRUE where delinquency_status is XX, FALSE otherwise. Use it with delinquency_months to tell "not known" from "blank".
